        for (int cost : costs) {
            if (totalCost + cost <= budget) {
                totalCost += cost;
                cutCount++;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.print(cutCount);
    }
}

        int cuts = 0;
        while (!pq.isEmpty() && totalSpent + pq.peek() <= budget) {
            totalSpent += pq.poll();
            cuts++;
        }
        
        System.out.print(cuts);
